QUESTION:

Create a number counter that counts infinitely:

1. Create a variable and name it "num".

2. "num" will start at 0 and increase by 1 every second. Display "num" on the LCD as it counts.

    Example of the exectuion:

    Display

      0             at the start
      1             after 1 sec
      2             after 2 sec
      3
      ...

QUESTION:

Create a digital clock that displays the time on the LCD in the format "hour : min : sec".

1. Create 3 variables and name them "hour", "min" and "sec".

2. The time will start at "0:0:0" and runs eternally.

    Example of the exectuion:

    Display
    0:0:0      at the start
    0:0:1      after 1 second
    0:0:2 
    ...

    0:0:59    after 59 seconds 
    0:1:0      after 1 minute
    0:1:1
    ...

    0:59:59   after 59min 59 secs
    1:0:0       after 1 hour
    1:0:1

3. When the time reaches "23:59:59", it will reset to "0:0:0" and continues.
